overview.description: The Global X MLCC & Electronic Components ETF (MLCC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The Global X The fund & Electronic Components ETF (Fund) seeks to achieve capital appreciation. MLCC was launched on Sep 10, 2026 and is issued by Global X.

data.title: Global X Launches New ETF With Precision Focus: Building Blocks of AI Infrastructure
data.text: NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Global X launches a new ETF that seeks to invest in the makers of multi-layer ceramic capacitors (MLCCs), key building blocks of modern electronics.

news.t: Global X Launches New ETF With Precision Focus: Building Blocks of AI Infrastructure

holdings.infoBox: MLCC is an equity ETF with a total of 17 individual holdings. The top holdings are Murata Manufacturing stock at 20.95%, Samsung Electro-Mechanics at 20.66%, Yageo at 14.64%, TDK Corporation at 13.86%, and Taiyo Yuden at 6.89%.
